articles.title: Building an Enterprise AI Customer Support Platform with Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Code
articles.summary_raw:
Most AI coding demos stop at task managers, weather apps, or simple chatbots. For this project, we take on something more demanding: building an enterprise customer-support platform that can investigate complaints, retrieve relevant policies, recommend resolutions, and keep risky actions behind human approval.
